Compounding these geopolitical and economic stressors is a noticeable uptick in significant global seismic activity across multiple tectonic regions. Therefore, it is imperative to: 1) Immediately diversify and secure critical supply chains for essential resources like food and energy, exploring regional alternatives to mitigate geopolitical choke point vulnerabilities. 2) Drastically strengthen cybersecurity postures, conducting comprehensive audits and fortifying defenses against state-sponsored attacks, especially for operations reliant on targeted US tech infrastructure. 3) Review and update emergency preparedness and continuity plans for all personnel and physical assets, given the heightened global seismic instability and potential for cascading disruptions.
